10小时终于结束通关了蒲公英结局，眼镜妹妹挺好的，我很满意。只是整个游戏体验真的太差了，作为一个恐怖游戏，它用了最廉价的恐怖方式，甚至有些女鬼，明明都已经看到它了，却还阴魂不散的跟着，非得突脸尖叫一声不可。解密也是借到吐，谜题有点抽象了，到最后看着流程攻略通关的，因为实在不知道该去哪该干嘛。还有那个保安，一直追一直追，又不恐怖，他还拿这个手电筒一直追！

那个因为女儿而阴魂不散的母亲很令人同情，阿弥陀佛，母爱多么伟大。
有缘看到我这个测评的还没开始玩的仁兄，听我一个通关之后的建议：一定要玩最简单模式，我就是玩了普通模式，导致没有任务提示，所以体验很差，听说简单模式有指引的。
端游的交互和判定模块和shi没什么区别，
看UP主打了几遍，但是其实被老大爷追的时候还是有点紧张，然后就是有难找道具吧，妹子们都是美的，喜欢玩追逐战的推荐

Played the game for 5 straight hours and apparently I was STILL in the starting area of the game. Puzzles made no sense, and I had brute force figure out the first boss through trail and several death error. I was invested in the first hour, but after 4 hours of not knowing where the F to go, and being so INFURIATED by the DAMN JANITOR, I had enough. Never have I dropped a game in my life, I even slogged through Siren/Forbidden Siren (Which you can brute force you way through with anger and frustration but the story made it worth it) If they removed the janitor or nerfed his AI I think it would be a much fairer game, even when I found a potential puzzle clue, the F-ing Janitor would find me and I'd be hidden in a bathroom for 90% of my gaming time. May as well call it "sit in a bathroom stall simulator" or "We have Siren at home". 
Janitor started off funny and suspenseful after 4 hours of his BS I wanted to throw my mouse and keyboard AND controller out the window. Didn't even get to really see any scares, so can't even rate this as a horror game, unless your idea of horror is SUFFERING THROUGH WAITING 5 MINS A TIME FOR THE DAMN JANITOR TO GET LOST, certainly my idea of hell. I'm never coming back to this game, which is a shame as the story seemed interesting if I want a spooky asian school/ghost horror I think I'll just get Yomawari Lost In The Dark instead.
